dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight convex protrusion along the left lateral margin (image right) posterior to the nuchal region; right margin (image left) exhibits a subtle indentation at a similar axial position.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate-grey median pixel intensity distributed across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency, fine-scale mottling composed of lighter-grey micro-patches distributed uniformly across the dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single, high-contrast dark circular feature on the anterior dorsal plane corresponding to the blowhole.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct longitudinal indentation or ridge extending along the central dorsal axis in the posterior half of the visible body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A sharp, straight longitudinal mark or ridge is present on the posterior dorsal midline.
